answer: A sybil tax stops bulk fake identities. Each new identity pays a non-refundable 60-unit fee before trading, twice its expected 30-day earnings of 30 units. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 units, burned outright, while each fake earns at most 30, so attacks lose. Like a glacier, the fee grinds forgery down slowly. An honest agent crosses the ocean once, pays 60 once, and keeps undiluted rewards. One ember of fraud cannot warm the market.
